name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is an advanced-stage developer focused on its 100%-owned Diablillos silver-gold project in the Salta province of Argentina, which hosts one of the largest undeveloped primary silver resources globally at approximately 248 Moz silver and 2.54 Moz gold. The company has completed a Preliminary Feasibility Study demonstrating robust project economics with a US$494M after-tax NPV and 26% IRR. AbraSilver is backed by strategic investors including Kinross Gold and Eric Sprott, and also holds the earlier-stage La Coipita copper-gold project in San Juan, Argentina.
